messages:
alex: Heads-up — I spotted inconsistent timeout parameter names across our SDK docs and quickstart snippets. Python examples use `timeout_seconds=5`, JS snippets use `deadlineMs: 5000`, and Go examples just show `context.WithTimeout(...)`. Users are getting confused. Can we pick a single user-facing name for quickstarts and snippets?

mira: I prefer `timeout_ms` so it's unambiguous about units.

sam: +1 on being explicit. One caveat: some SDKs (Go) idiomatically use context, and backend semantics are seconds. But for copy/paste examples `timeout_ms` is clear.

jordan: Also found an errref page that still uses `deadline` in prose. We should sweep docs/errref and examples. I'll grep and list occurrences.

alex: Proposal: unify examples to `timeout_ms` in JS/Python/HTTP examples, keep an idiomatic Go snippet using `context.WithTimeout` but add a short comment mapping it to `timeout_ms`. Add a small migration note: how to convert ms -> seconds and how SDK timeout differs from server `Retry-After`.

mira: I'll open a PR to do the changes. Planning to update quickstart snippets, SDK example pages, and the errref timeout sections. Any objections?

sam: No objections. Suggestion: include a tiny equivalence table in the errref: `timeout_ms: 5000` => `timeout_seconds=5` (Python), and show `context.WithTimeout(ctx, 5*time.Second)` for Go. Also call out that `Retry-After` is server-suggested backoff, not the same as client timeout.

jordan: Good call. Also remember streaming: cancel semantics differ when streaming tokens — add a short note under streaming examples.

alex: Action items: mira opens PR; sam & jordan review; alex will update the CLI/quickstart shell snippets. @docs-bot can you tag the PR with docs/sync and snippet-lint?

docs-bot: docs-bot: Created task checklist template: [x] update snippets, [ ] update errref table, [ ] add migration note, [ ] run snippet linter. Will post CI status when the PR is created.

mira: PR opened WIP: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345 — replaced `deadline`/`timeout_seconds` with `timeout_ms` in 12 files. Left TODOs where Go context examples need manual wording. Snippet linter passes locally except for one streaming example.

sam: I'll take the review tomorrow morning. Tiny nit: make sure links to SDK reference use the canonical SDK param name (we should add a mapping note if SDKs still expose different param names).

jordan: I'll draft the errref table and streaming caveat and paste into the PR as a review comment.

alex: :thumbsup: goal is to merge by EOD Friday. If anyone hits blockers, flag here.

docs-bot: docs-bot: PR #2345 updated — snippet IDs changed (781 -> 789), link-check job queued.

mira: Updated the PR with the table and a short migration example. I also added a one-line note in the 429/timeout errref: "Client SDK timeout (client-side abort) is distinct from server `Retry-After` (server-suggested backoff)."

sam: LGTM pending small wording nit in the Go example. I'll fix that in a follow-up commit.

jordan: Verified grep: 9 occurrences of `deadline` across docs. I left comments on the PR where I found them.

alex: Thanks team. We'll merge after sam's nit and CI. Follow-ups on the PR thread.
